scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=../app/src/main/assets/www/app.js && cp index.html style.css ../app/src/main/assets/www/ && mkdir -p ../app/src/main/assets/www/fonts && for w in 400 500 600 700; do cp node_modules/@fontsource/fredoka/files/fredoka-latin-$w-normal.woff2 ../app/src/main/assets/www/fonts/fredoka-$w.woff2; done
